upstream.notes: Real mermaid 11.16.0 erDiagram geometry captured via headless Chrome with the bundled Noto fonts. Every table with its name, rows, cells and dividers, every relationship path with its markers, and every label, normalized to the first source-order entity's centre (index 0), matching Muffin's FlowchartLayout origin subtraction. cardA/cardB recovered from crow's-foot markers (marker-start=cardA at entityA, marker-end=cardB at entityB). Relationship paths are in document order. Compare against er::ErScene::toJsonObject.

oracle: erDiagram.render tables, relationship paths, labels and canvas (first-entity normalized)
